title: Classification API Endpoints
description: Public API endpoints for property classification data. Created 6 endpoints to fetch categories, subcategories, types, configurations, usage types, investment types, and full classification tree. All endpoints are cached and optimized for frontend consumption.
features: All endpoints return only active (is_active=true) records
acceptance_criteria: Filter by category_id works on subcategories
Filter by subcategory_id works on types
Classification tree endpoint returns nested structure
result_summary: Complete classification API with 6 public endpoints. Frontend can fetch categories, filter subcategories/types, get configurations, usage types, investment types, and full nested tree. All endpoints cached, ordered, and returning only active records. Production-ready for website and dashboard integration.
